leadText: Apricot's Valentine (Japanese: 小梅のバレンタイン 's Valentine) is the fifty-eighth chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.
plainText:
Apricot's Valentine (Japanese: 小梅のバレンタイン 's Valentine) is the fifty-eighth chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
Apricot makes candy to give to Walnut for Valentine's Day but, during , she finds out there's already a girl he's in love with. She doesn't know that he's actually in love with Apricot's unmasked form.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Apricot
Walnut
